item.title: [github_trending] morluto/rea
item.description: REA (Reverse Engineer Anything) is an open-source project from morluto that packages reverse engineering into a single MCP covering native binaries, applications and runtime behavior; it ships as the npm package rea-agents and requires Node.js. It is aimed at security researchers who want reverse-engineering steps callable from an agent workflow, and at anyone trying to understand how a feature works down at the binary level. The README is available in over a dozen languages.

item.title: [juejin] Cursor 转 Codex 大半个月，聊聊我的真实感受
item.description: A Juejin post in which a developer describes spending roughly half a month in Codex after switching from Cursor. His takeaway is that Cursor still reads as an AI coding assistant, while Codex feels closer to a general-purpose agent that carries out tasks on its own. Useful for developers deciding which tool to adopt for daily work.

item.title: [v2ex] [Linux] libcr 项目组发布 Youtube 下载器 crYGet 0.9.0 for Linux
item.description: The libcr team released crYGet 0.9.0 for Linux, a YouTube downloader written in pure C++ and built from chromium 154, bundling the v8 and media modules so users don't need ffmpeg or yt-dlp installed separately. The authors say the code came from having AI analyze yt-dlp's Python implementation, and that the Linux and Windows builds share a consistent UI.

item.title: [v2ex] [分享创造] [开源自部署] 芯语伴 SprechMate，和 AI 练口语纠音（23 种语言），填 API 接近免费用
item.description: SprechMate is an open-source speaking-practice tool shipped as a single-file static PWA (index.html) that runs on your own OpenAI-compatible LLM key plus a free Microsoft Azure Speech key. It covers 23 languages with AI chat, one-click native-voice playback, read-aloud recording and phoneme-level pronunciation scoring. Keys, chat history and audio caches stay in local IndexedDB, and deployment is a drag-and-drop upload to Cloudflare Pages.

item.title: [v2ex] [程序员] 刚刷到个黑客松，给开源 CLI 修 bug 就能拿钱
item.description: A V2EX user shared an online hackathon with two tracks. In one, you wire the organizers' tests into your own GitHub repo within seven days so every PR runs them, competing for a $3,000 prize pool across the top five places, and past projects are eligible. The other pays at least $50 per merged fix to their open-source CLI, from a $1,000 pool, with no deployment or test setup required.

item.title: [infoq] TypeScript 终于能编译成原生程序了？启动快 12 倍，运行却慢 7.5 倍
item.description: Vercel Labs released scriptc, an Apache-2.0 experimental compiler that turns ordinary TypeScript into small native executables containing no Node, V8 or any JavaScript engine; the repo already has roughly 4,900 stars. Its CLI starts in a median 1.78ms and the binaries boot about 12x faster than Node 24 with 72x less memory, but a community benchmark found runtime around 7.5x slower, with Hono requiring --dynamic and pushing 62% of code into embedded QuickJS at 18.4k requests per second.

item.title: [v2ex] [分享创造] 做了个小站，想帮去香港看赛的朋友看懂赛卡（hkracecard.com）
item.description: RaceProb (hkracecard.com) is a solo-built helper for Hong Kong horse racing: before each race it offers a "sealed double pick" and lists the supporting, unfavorable and missing factors for every horse, meant to be read alongside the official race card. The author draws clear lines — it is not a tips site, does not mirror Jockey Club odds, and its scores are not win probabilities. It is still early, and he is asking for feedback on whether the explanations are clear and what to cut.

item.title: [infoq] Cloudflare 详解从 WordPress 迁移至 EmDash 的过程
item.description: Cloudflare has moved its main blog off WordPress onto EmDash, its in-house open-source CMS written in TypeScript that runs on Workers with Workers Cache plus a Workers KV-backed object cache, connecting to PlanetScale through Hyperdrive. A proxy Worker routed requests by version cookie, scaling from 1% to 100% of traffic in a day and falling back to the old site on 500 errors. Cloudflare reports far steadier p95 latency than the old stack and capacity tested at 7,000 RPS.

item.description: aicoding.inc is a China-facing API relay for models such as Claude, which its author says now serves tens of thousands of individual users and more than 200 enterprise customers. Traffic was switched to domestic direct connections so long multi-turn agent runs in tools like Cline survive, and billing is handled via local payment or corporate transfer. Usage is charged at 19%, 29% or 49% of official list price, with $10 in credit for joining the community.

item.description: An InfoQ piece argues the gap between an AI Agent demo and production isn't the model but the Agent Harness around it: memory, tool and MCP access, retrieval and orchestration on the development side, plus observability, guardrails, routing and cost control on the ops side. It splits the harness into dev and ops halves, compares a managed Harness-as-a-Service with a self-managed stack, and builds the same FinBot agent both ways as a walkthrough.

The talk covers Mira, an open source governance agent built on Kimi Agent Harness that runs issue triage, PR review, dependency and license scanning and vulnerability response, using progressive authorization, human-in-the-loop review and full audit trails to address whether teams dare let an agent act.

Aimed at developers who want a maintainable skill set for their coding agents.

item.description: A front-end interviewer recaps the 2026 autumn hiring season: with the team expanding, they worked through more than 30 résumés and ran 22 technical interviews, ending with 3 offers and 2 actual hires. Only that opening is available in the source, so the interview questions and candidate assessments that follow aren't included; relevant to developers preparing for front-end interviews or running hiring loops.

item.title: [github_trending] anthropics/knowledge-work-plugins
item.description: Anthropic open-sourced 11 plugins for knowledge workers to use in Claude Cowork, each bundling the skills, connectors, slash commands and sub-agents for a specific job function, and they also work with Claude Code. The company says the out-of-the-box versions are only a starting point and the real value comes from customizing them with your own tools, terminology and processes.

item.title: [github_trending] addyosmani/agent-skills
item.description: addyosmani/agent-skills packages the workflows, quality gates and best practices senior engineers rely on into "skills" that AI coding agents follow, spanning six phases from DEFINE and PLAN through BUILD, VERIFY and REVIEW to SHIP. It ships 9 slash commands such as /spec, /plan, /build and /test mapped to those stages, aimed at developers who want agents to apply engineering standards consistently.

item.title: [github_trending] alibaba/open-code-review
item.description: OpenCodeReview is Alibaba's open-source code review tool, pairing deterministic pipelines with an LLM agent to produce precise line-level comments, backed by a built-in multi-language ruleset covering issues such as NPE. The project says it is battle-tested at Alibaba's scale, which makes it relevant to teams that want fast static checks and semantic review in one CI workflow.

item.title: [github_trending] Robbyant/lingbot-map
item.description: LingBot-Map is a feed-forward 3D foundation model from the Robbyant team, built on a Geometric Context Transformer for streaming 3D reconstruction; its paper is listed as an ECCV 2026 Best Paper Award candidate. Code is released under Apache-2.0 with weights on HuggingFace and ModelScope, making it worth tracking for researchers working on streaming 3D reconstruction and SLAM.

item.title: [github_trending] BerriAI/litellm
item.description: LiteLLM is an open-source AI gateway with a Rust core and Python SDK that lets you call 100+ LLM APIs in OpenAI format, adding cost tracking, guardrails, load balancing and logging on top. It is self-hosted and enterprise-oriented, spans backends such as Bedrock, Azure, OpenAI and Anthropic, and ships deploy templates for Render, Railway, AWS and GCP.
